_comment: WXAI dual-arm differential-drive contract. Dimension meanings are mirrored in lmm/policy/wxai_transforms.py, which is the executable source of truth; this file exists so the contract is reviewable without reading code.

embodiment.note: NOT Mobile ALOHA. Not dual ViperX, not a Slate omnidirectional base.

delta_action_mask_note: 14 elements, not 16. DeltaActions computes dims=len(mask) and indexes state[..., :dims]; state is 14-D, so a 16-element mask raises. The prefix stopping at 14 is what keeps base dims absolute.

base.forward_sign: positive base_vel[0] moves along the robot's local +x in base_transformation
base.yaw_sign: positive base_vel[1] DECREASES arctan2(heading.z, heading.x); magnitude ang_speed/120 per step
base.verified_on: A800 2026-09-20, 6 headings x 60 steps in free space, 2.0833 mm/step at every heading

normalization.note: trossen / trossen_mobile statistics describe dual ViperX arms and a Slate omnidirectional base. They are dimensionally compatible (14-D state, 16-D action) but semantically wrong for WXAI, and dims 14-15 have been redefined from vx/vy to forward/yaw. New statistics MUST be computed from WXAI data before fine-tuning.

control.method: one env.step advances exactly 1/120 s: yaw 0.5/120 rad/step and forward 0.25/120 m/step, measured independently
control.note: The previous nominal 50 Hz was wrong. Any dataset fps must be derived from 120 Hz, not assumed.

physics.reason: allow_dyn_slide=False raises AttributeError: 'OVMMSim' object has no attribute 'get_collisions' on this Habitat revision. True is the only runnable setting, not a preference. The overlay yaml still declares false and is unrunnable as written.

gripper.note: _set_motor_pos updates the motor target correctly (0.044 -> 0.0) but the articulation is driven kinematically (ArmAbsPosKinematicAction), so physics never integrates it and the carriages never move. Writing joint_positions directly actuates them and survives env.step.
